pick.headline: Saddam links withdrawal from Kuwait to Israel's occupied territories
pick.fbis: The Near East & South Asia Daily Report of August 13, 1990, carried Palestinian reaction to Saddam's linkage proposal: PLO factions denouncing US plans, the PLO envoy in Rome calling it the moment to settle all occupations, and Radio Monte Carlo quoting West Bank figures praising "the Iraqi proposal."

alternates.headline: Israel's heaviest bombardment of West Beirut
alternates.fbis: The Middle East & Africa Daily Report of August 13, 1982, reported Israeli forces attacked west and southern Beirut for almost 11 hours before the August 12 cease-fire, and Washington's "furious reaction" to the bombing.
